brief:
Artists in Gaza have painted murals on destroyed walls to honour US rapper Macklemore for his public support of Palestine, according to Al Jazeera English. The murals appear on structures damaged during conflict in the territory.

Macklemore has emerged as a prominent voice among American musicians expressing solidarity with Palestinians. The artist's advocacy has resonated with Gaza's creative community, which continues producing work amid the territory's humanitarian challenges.
dek: Artists in Gaza are painting murals on destroyed walls, honouring US rapper Macklemore for his support for Palestine.
title: Gaza artists paint murals honoring Macklemore's Palestine support
